name: TechRisk-EventLogic-Bench
description: TechRisk-EventLogic-Bench supports query-driven causal-temporal reasoning over pre-constructed event logic graphs for technology-security risk analysis. The release contains 25 cases, 103 public official sources, 158 typed event nodes, 194 typed relations, and 202 expert-checked queries and support traces, including a 120-query main evaluation set. The benchmark evaluates answer quality, support-trace recovery, trace boundaries, grounded answer support, and support-sensitive uncertainty. It does not evaluate raw Web crawling or automatic event-graph construction. Each source record includes provenance metadata and a public URL. The deposit contains only TechRisk-EventLogic-Bench; MAVEN-ERE and ChronoQA are not redistributed in this record. Associated paper: Query-Driven Causal-Temporal Reasoning over Event Logic Graphs for Technology-Security Risk Analysis.
